item.title: Cyclic Materials invests $82M in Chesterfield County
item.description: Cyclic Materials will invest more than $82 million in Chesterfield County to open a rare earth recycling facility, creating 90 jobs and supporting EV manufacturing. The post Cyclic Materials invests $82M in Chesterfield County appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Dave’s Hot Chicken opening new Anderson location
item.description: Dave’s Hot Chicken is opening a new Anderson location Feb. 6, expanding its South Caro-lina footprint and bringing Nashville-style hot chicken to the Upstate. The post Dave’s Hot Chicken opening new Anderson location appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Brooks Brothers to remain at King Street’s Victoria Center
item.description: Brooks Brothers will continue operating its King Street store at Victoria Center, reinforcing the retailer’s long-term commitment to downtown Charleston. The post Brooks Brothers to remain at King Street’s Victoria Center appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Blue Road Investments eyes September finish for Augusta Arbor II
item.description: Blue Road Investments is targeting a September completion for the Augusta Arbor II industrial park, adding 346,680 square feet near Interstate 185 in Greenville. The post Blue Road Investments eyes September finish for Augusta Arbor II appeared first on SCBiz.
